faqs.question: When are you open?
faqs.answer: Our regular team support hours are Monday–Saturday, 9 AM–6 PM. We're closed on Sundays. Our website AI assistant is available 24/7.

faqs.question: How can I contact you?
faqs.answer: You can reach BrandHive Studio through: WhatsApp / Phone: +94 70 641 0093, Email: brandhive.studio.lk@gmail.com, Website: www.brandhivestudio.com.lk. You can also find us on Instagram, Facebook and TikTok.

faqs.question: How do I get started?
faqs.answer: Simply tell us what you'd like to build or improve. We'll understand your requirements, recommend the most suitable BrandHive service, and arrange a quotation where needed.

faqs.question: Do I need to pay in advance?
faqs.answer: Yes. For most projects, we require a 50% advance to begin, with the remaining 50% due before final delivery. Larger or custom projects may use milestone-based payments.

faqs.question: Can I get an individual service instead of a package?
faqs.answer: Yes. Individual services are available across most categories, so you don't always need to choose a package.

faqs.question: Can you prepare a custom quotation?
faqs.answer: Yes. BrandHive Studio can prepare custom quotations based on your business goals, requirements and project scope.

faqs.question: Who owns the final work?
faqs.answer: Final approved deliverables are transferred to you after full payment, unless otherwise agreed in the quotation.

faqs.question: Do you handle domain and hosting?
faqs.answer: Domain registration, hosting and other third-party services are generally billed separately unless they're included in your quotation.

faqs.question: Do you offer ongoing support?
faqs.answer: Yes. Maintenance and ongoing support options are available depending on the service and package.

faqs.question: Are revisions included?
faqs.answer: Yes. Revision availability depends on the selected service, package or quotation.

faqs.question: How long will my project take?
faqs.answer: Delivery depends on the project scope, complexity and timely client feedback. Once we understand your requirements, the BrandHive team can provide a more accurate timeline.

faqs.question: Can I see your portfolio or past work?
faqs.answer: Absolutely! You can explore our work through the BrandHive Studio portfolio on our website.

faqs.question: What does BrandHive Studio do?
faqs.answer: BrandHive Studio is a premium creative agency providing Brand Strategy & Identity, Digital Experiences (websites & web apps), Growth Marketing (social media, TikTok, paid advertising), and Academic Technology services (software development mentoring).

faqs.question: How can I contact BrandHive Studio?
faqs.answer:
You can reach us via:
📱 WhatsApp / Phone: +94 70 641 0093
📧 Email: brandhive.studio.lk@gmail.com
🌐 Website: www.brandhivestudio.com.lk
We're also on Instagram, Facebook, and TikTok.

faqs.question: Where can I see your portfolio?
faqs.answer: Our portfolio is available at: https://brandhivestudio.com.lk/portfolio — You can view featured case studies and past projects there.

faqs.question: How much do you charge for a logo?
faqs.answer: Logo Design starts from LKR 8,000. If you're starting a new business and need a complete identity, our Starter Brand Identity package starts from LKR 15,000 and includes the logo, color palette, typography, and basic brand guidelines.

faqs.question: How much does a website cost?
faqs.answer: Our website packages start from LKR 35,000 (Starter), LKR 75,000 (Business), LKR 150,000 (Corporate), and Custom Quote for advanced web solutions. The final price depends on your specific requirements.

faqs.question: How much does social media management cost?
faqs.answer:
Social media packages:
• Starter Organic: LKR 14,000/month (15 posts)
• Starter + $20 Boosting: LKR 20,000/month
• Growth Organic: LKR 25,000/month (20 posts + 4 reels)
• Premium Organic: LKR 40,000/month (30 posts + 8 reels)

faqs.question: How much does TikTok video production cost?
faqs.answer:
TikTok production packages:
• Single Video: LKR 5,000
• Growth (4 Videos/month): LKR 18,000
• Premium (8 Videos/month): LKR 32,000
• Additional Video: LKR 5,000
Note: These do not include advertising/boosting budgets.

faqs.question: Do you require an advance payment?
faqs.answer: Yes. For most projects, we require a 50% advance to begin, with the remaining 50% due before final delivery. Larger or custom projects may use milestone-based payments.

faqs.question: What payment methods do you accept?
faqs.answer: We currently accept Cash and Bank Transfer.

faqs.question: Is domain and hosting included?
faqs.answer: Domain and hosting are third-party services and are generally billed separately unless they're specifically included in your quotation.

faqs.question: Is the advertising budget included in your social media packages?
faqs.answer: For most packages, advertising budgets are separate from BrandHive's service fee. The only exception is the Starter $20 Boosting package (LKR 20,000/month) which explicitly includes a $20 boosting allocation.

faqs.question: Can I get a discount?
faqs.answer: I can check with the BrandHive team regarding a special offer for your project. 😊

faqs.question: Can you give a custom quotation?
faqs.answer: Yes. BrandHive Studio can prepare custom quotations based on your business goals, requirements, and project scope.

faqs.question: How long is a quotation valid?
faqs.answer: Quotations are valid for 30 days from the date of issue unless otherwise stated.

faqs.question: Do you offer individual services or only packages?
faqs.answer: Yes, individual services are available across most categories, so you don't always need to choose a full package.

faqs.question: Do you manage TikTok separately from social media?
faqs.answer: Yes. TikTok video production is a dedicated service category. We offer TikTok video packages separately from general social media management. Note that TikTok advertising budgets are separate from production packages.

faqs.question: Do you offer academic project help?
faqs.answer: Yes. We provide mentoring, technical consultation, code review, debugging assistance, and project guidance for academic software projects. Students remain responsible for their own academic work per institutional requirements.

faqs.question: Do you do website maintenance?
faqs.answer: Yes. Website maintenance is available from LKR 8,000/month (individual service) or LKR 5,000/month (as a website add-on).

faqs.question: Do you offer SEO services?
faqs.answer: Yes. SEO Optimization starts from LKR 15,000. We also include Basic SEO in our Starter Website package and Advanced SEO in higher-tier website packages.

faqs.question: How do I get started with BrandHive Studio?
faqs.answer: Simply tell us what you'd like to build or improve. We'll understand your requirements, recommend the most suitable service, and arrange a quotation where needed. You can reach us via WhatsApp at +94 70 641 0093 or through our website.

faqs.question: What is the project process?
faqs.answer: Our process: Discovery → Strategy → Design → Development → Launch. For larger projects, this may include milestone-based checkpoints.

faqs.question: How long does a project take?
faqs.answer: Delivery depends on the project scope, complexity, and timely client feedback. Once we understand your requirements, the BrandHive team can provide a more accurate timeline.

faqs.question: How many revisions are included?
faqs.answer: Revision availability depends on the selected package or quotation. The exact allowance is specified per package. Please ask about the specific package you're interested in.

faqs.question: What happens if I delay providing feedback or content?
faqs.answer: Project timelines depend on client feedback, content, approvals, and required information. If client inputs are delayed, the project timeline may be extended. BrandHive may pause a project when necessary inputs are unavailable.

faqs.question: What is the cancellation policy?
faqs.answer: Before work begins: Cancellation may qualify for a refund of the unused advance portion after deducting completed work and non-refundable third-party costs. After work begins: Payments for completed work are non-refundable. Third-party services (domain, hosting, advertising) are subject to each provider's own terms.

faqs.question: Can I request a refund?
faqs.answer: Refund eligibility depends on the project stage, completed work, third-party costs, and agreed terms. Please contact our Client Relations Team for review.

faqs.question: What academic project types do you support?
faqs.answer: We support web applications, mobile apps, AI/ML projects, database systems, desktop applications, software engineering projects, and general software development projects at academic level.

faqs.question: Will you complete my assignment for me?
faqs.answer: No. BrandHive provides mentoring, guidance, code review, and technical consultation only. Students remain responsible for completing and submitting their own academic work according to their institution's integrity requirements.
